function.name: run_study_trial
function.description: Run one fresh Newton-Raphson AC trial. load_scale multiplies ALL loads' P/Q and observes bus_voltage; line_rating scales one line max_i_ka and observes line_loading; gen_dispatch scales one generator P and observes trafo_loading. Use operation=none for base/N-1 reports. Returns actual measurements, not a fitted answer. element_id selects the modified line/generator (unused for all-load scaling). observation_id selects the observed bus/line/transformer. Omit contingency_line (or pass null) for the intact network; an integer takes that line out of service, and 0 is a real line. status=constraint_violation with metric_valid=true is still a usable measurement: compare voltage_violations with base_case_voltage_violations, which the unmodified case already has.
